purpose: Release capability manifest. One row per exposed TurboMCP operation, with its support boundary, effect class, release disposition and required evidence. Seeded from the declarations; `effects` stays `unknown` until the implementation has been read or exercised, and `evidence` stays empty until a required case passes.
